description: The Codex app-server writes a line that is not JSON-RPC, three stderr lines (the middle one echoing the fake OPENAI_API_KEY the test sets in settings env), then exits 1. The reader must report the exit with the redacted tail. No handshake: it never reads stdin.

note: The value is the fake key the test puts in settings env; the tail must show [redacted].

stderr.line: codex app-server: the key fakeOpenAiKey0123456 was refused
